spans.s:
मिल् मिल् (thought by some to be ori-
ginally a Nom. fr. a Prākṛt form मिल्ल
= मिश्र), cl. 6. P. A. मिलति, -ते, मिमेल, मि-
मिले, मेलितुम्, (generally P.) to unite, be united
with, join, accompany; to meet together, come toge-
ther; to meet, assemble, associate; to mix, combine,
be present at; to be connected with; to meet or fall
in with (with inst. or gen. or loc. of the person or
with सह and inst.); to find; to meet, encounter,
(द्वन्द्व-युद्धेन द्वौ मिलितौ, two persons
met in single combat); to clash, impinge, concur;
[]
to happen, come to pass: Caus. मेलयति, -यितुम्, to
cause to meet, bring together, assemble, convene.

मील् मील् (connected with rt. 1. मिष्,
and perhaps originally a Nom.), cl. 1.
P. मीलति, मिमील, मीलिष्यति, अमीलीत्, मीलितुम्,
to close (the eyes), wink, twinkle, close or contract
the eyelids; to close, be closed (as the eyes); to fade,
disappear, vanish; to assemble, gather together, be col-
lected (= rt. मिल् intransitively): Caus. मीलयति, Aor.
अमिमीलत् and अमीमिलत्, to cause to close, close
(applied to the blossom of flowers as well as to the
eyes): Desid. मिमीलिषति: Intens. मेमील्यते.

मिलत्, अन्, अती or अन्ती, अत्, joining, accompanying;
meeting; assembling; concurring, combining; hap-
pening.
—मिलद्-व्याध, अस्, आ, अम्, uniting with
hunters, accompanied by huntsmen.

मीलत्, अन्, अन्ती, अत्, closing (as the eyes); wink-
ing, twinkling.

मिलन, अम्, n. the act of mixing with, coming
in contact with, associating with; concurring, en-
countering, coalescing, meeting; contact.

मीलन, अम्, n. the act of closing the eyes;
winking, blinking, twinkling; the closing of a
flower; (in rhetoric) a covert or concealed simile,
see मीलित below.

मिलित, अस्, आ, अम्, united, mixed, combined,
connected; found, met, encountered.

मीलित, अस्, आ, अम्, closed; twinkled; half opened,
unblown, partly opened (as a young bud &c.); dis-
appeared, vanished; assembled, gathered together;
(अम्), n. a simile merely implied (e. g. क्षौम-
वत्यो न लक्ष्यन्ते ज्योत्स्नायाम्, ‘clad in linen
they are not perceived in the moonlight,’ where
comparison between the whiteness of the linen and
of the moonlight is implied.)
मिलित्वा, ind. having met together, having united.

मिलिन्, ई, इनी, इ, mixing with, combined with,
provided with, possessing.
मिला मिला in दुर्-मिला, q. v.
मिल्ला मिल्ला, f., N. of a woman.

मिलिन्दक मिलिन्दक, अस्, m. a kind of
snake.

मिलीमिलिन् मिलीमिलिन्, ई, m. an epithet of
Śiva (which is said to contain a Mantra addressed to
Śiva, consisting of the following eighteen syllables,
ॐ, रुद्र चीलि चीलि चिलि चिलि मिलि मिलि, ॐ स्वाहा).
मीलयित्वा, ind. having closed (as the eyes).
